name: social-content-team
description: Social media content creation team focusing on high-converting copy, viral hooks, visual storyboards, poster layouts, and creative direction across multi-platforms

displayDescription.en: High-converting social media copy, viral hooks, camera motion prompts, visual storyboards, and poster layouts for Xiaohongshu, TikTok, Instagram, X, and YouTube.
displayDescription.zh: 覆盖小红书、抖音、TikTok、Instagram、X 等全平台的高转化爆款文案、黄金钩子、视觉分镜脚本与动态海报设计

defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me create high-converting social media copy and a visual storyboard
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我为我的产品/选题创作一套高转化社媒文案与分镜方案

quickPrompts.en: Help me write a Xiaohongshu seed post with viral hooks
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我写一篇小红书爆款种草文案并配上吸睛钩子

quickPrompts.en: Design a 5-shot video storyboard and prompt for this script
quickPrompts.zh: 基于这篇口播文案设计 5 个镜头的分镜脚本与生成提示词

quickPrompts.en: Create 3 different angles of ad copy for A/B testing
quickPrompts.zh: 为这款产品提炼 3 个不同受众角度的信息流广告文案变体
